name: Sentry
summary: Connect a Sentry organization: new and growing issues light up the Log activity area, and a Sentry tab aggregates unresolved errors by issue, project, and level.

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Read unresolved issues from the Sentry organization you connect, using the API key you provide
Add Sentry issue activity to the Log page, its activity lights, and its filter chips
Keep the Sentry API key, connection details, and the last issue snapshot on this device until the package is removed
Open a Sentry issue or your organization's issue list in your browser

screenshots.alt: Log page Sentry tab listing unresolved issues with event and user counts, beside activity lights with the Sentry lane lit
